cards.title: Counting with a dictionary
cards.body: Use each letter as a key and its count as the value. `d.get(key, 0)` gives the value, or 0 when the key is missing.

cards.title: Keys in order
cards.body: `sorted(d)` gives the keys in order: alphabetical for strings.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should count each letter, but crashes with a `KeyError` on the very first one. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: A new letter is not in the dictionary yet. `counts.get(ch, 0) + 1` starts it at 0.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: p appears twice in "pop", so its count is 2.

exercise.prompt: Read a word in lowercase letters and print how many times each letter appears, one per line as `letter count`, in alphabetical order.
